name: SaaSCity

sources.title: SaaSCity pricing — Free / Quick Pass / Premium / Max tiers
SaaSCity interactive map with 'Submit my project' entry point

conditions: Free plan requires embedding the SaaSCity badge on your site (verified during submission)
Free listings face a ~203-day review queue and publish on scheduled Monday drops
requirements: SaaS/startup product suitable for a public listing
Human review applies to every listing; paid plans get priority review within 24h
A live site where the badge can be placed (free path only)
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline/description and logo
Badge HTML ready to embed on the site footer/homepage for the free path
A preferred spot in mind for the isometric city map placement (included on all plans once approved)
workflow: Open https://saascity.io/saascity?submit=1 (Submit my project / Add Project)
Choose Free, Quick Pass ($19.99), Premium ($39.99) or Max ($99) — all one-time
On Free: add the site badge and wait for verification during submission
Join the queue (free) or get priority review within 24h (paid)
After approval, pick the building's map placement
watchFor: ~203-day stated wait on the free queue — the paid Quick Pass exists specifically to skip it
Premium adds an editor-written launch blog post (3 dofollow links); Max adds a 2x2 map building, 5-link post, and 30-day billboard/ticker/homepage ads
Badge verification happens during submission on the free path
Site offers an MCP server for agents at /mcp and an llms.txt
countsAsLive: The product's building is visible on the SaaSCity interactive map and its listing page on saascity.io resolves with a followed link.
unknowns: Exact submit-form fields (submission surface is a JS-rendered map app)
Whether an account is required before the submit flow
Actual vs stated queue time for free listings
